profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer, Information Lifecycle Governance at IBM

positions.locationName: Silicon Valley Lab, San Jose, CA

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, IBM® Information Lifecycle Governance
positions.description:
2014 - present | Senior Software Engineer | Information Lifecycle Governance (ILG)

IBM® data lifecycle management solutions help manage business information throughout its lifecycle, from requirements to retirement. The solutions support a range of application systems, databases and storage media—including big data environments.

Responsible for the design and development of fast storage, retrieval, indexing and search of unstructured document data. Implement security infrastructure and design of full text indexing pipeline for fast document ingestion, analysis and search. Work with quality testing team to evaluate and improve performance in all architecture components.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer, IBM® eDiscovery
positions.description:
2012 - 2015 (3 years) | Senior Software Engineer | IBM eDiscovery Manager®

Team lead for the IBM eDiscovery Manager® product development. This application provides an enterprise solution for searching, managing and exporting of high-volume electronic data. 

Responsible for designing and implementing security infrastructure, parsing of email document content (EML/Notes/MSG/SMTP), query language syntax and translation support for Verity and NetSearch search engines, metadata and repository configuration, and export of document data. Developed back-end services to help with scalability, performance, reliability and fault tolerance in retrieving, analyzing, searching and exporting million of documents.


2008 - 2012 (4 years) | Senior Software Engineer | IBM eDiscovery Analyzer®

Team lead for the IBM eDiscovery Analyzer® product development. This application featured advanced data analytics, content classification, full-text indexing and search, and processing large volumes of unstructured data for legal discovery. IBM eDiscovery employed the use of open source projects, such as Apache and UIMA, as well as IBM Lucene extensions to enable features like facet/category counting.


2004 - 2008 (4 years) | Advisory Software Engineer | IBM OmniFind Enterprise Edition®

Developed a scalable, distributed, highly available, and secure enterprise search application to help companies maximize the value of their enterprise information. Implemented subsystems to parse document content, perform linguistic document analysis, scale out query performance, and provide high search index availability.

positions.title: Advisory Software Engineer, Lotus Discovery Server
positions.description: Team lead for the Discovery Server product using WebSphere, J2EE and DB2 technologies. Designed  a distributed service architecture to analyze document data by implementing and integrating document crawlers, search engines, metrics recording and expertise location modules. Developed solutions for data clustering, classification, document analytics and language parsing for the various products in the Discovery Server portfolio.

positions.title: Software Engineer, Operating Systems
positions.description: Developed and provided support for the SV2 operating system kernel using C, C++ and MIPS/CAL assembly language. Help design and implement several of the kernel subsystems including virtual memory system, interrupt/exception handlers, system calls and file systems. Provided system administration and support to large-scale supercomputer client organizations. Resolved problems and address deficiencies by delivering fixes and enhancements to the operating system. Produced documentation guides and technical specifications for the SV2 operating system.

positions.title: Programmer Analyst, UniChem Computational Chemistry
positions.description: Designed and implemented graphical user interface and libraries for UniChem quantum chemistry application using C, C++, GL, OpenGL, XLib and Motif. Planed and coordinated product release schedule. Provided customer support for deployment and problem reporting of UniChem application.
